_usage: python3 business/tools/gemini.py planche.png "<prompt>" --ratio 16:9 --size 1K ; puis python3 business/tools/fx-sprites.py planche.png <famille> [--key luma] [--skip ...]
_fond: objets opaques : chroma-key green (#00FF00) ; objets clairs ou lumineux (seeds, lanterns) : pure black (#000000) + --key luma
petals: Sprite sheet for an animation: 12 separate cherry blossom and rose petals, soft pink, cream and blush tones, painted in a delicate gouache/watercolor style with subtle light and shadow, each petal a different shape and angle (flat, tilted, slightly curled, seen edge-on). Petals scattered with generous empty space between them, none touching, none cut by the border. Background: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key green (#00FF00), no shadows cast on the background, no texture, no text.
